subject.title: [Android] camera.snap missing, location.get not implemented, canvas.present broken on v2026.6.11

question: Should Android follow-up preserve the current gateway.nodes.allowCommands and node-approval gates while fixing diagnostics/A2UI readiness, or intentionally broaden Android camera/location command exposure?
rationale: Camera and location expose sensitive device data, and source inspection shows both implemented commands and intentional authorization gates; automation should not decide to loosen that boundary from this report alone.

options.title: Verify and preserve gates
options.body: Run current-main Android proof, keep camera.snap/camera.clip behind allowCommands, and repair only confirmed advertising, reapproval, settings, or A2UI readiness defects.

options.title: Broaden exposure intentionally
options.body: Change Android command exposure only with explicit security/product approval, docs updates, and tests proving denyCommands, approval, and user settings still hold.

options.title: Split after live proof
options.body: If current-main proof shows independent causes, split camera, location, and A2UI into separate owner-reviewed follow-ups with the reporter's evidence linked.

recommendation.title: Verify and preserve gates
recommendation.body: Run current-main Android proof, keep camera.snap/camera.clip behind allowCommands, and repair only confirmed advertising, reapproval, settings, or A2UI readiness defects.

likelyOwner.reason: The pending decision is Android app behavior and user-facing command availability, and the Android README routes Android issues to this owner.
